outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single representative fluorescence images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge) for each transfection condition with no quantification, and neither the panel nor the caption states how many times the experiment was performed or what kind of replicate (independent experiments, cells, dishes) the image represents.

The bar graphs quantifying JC-1 (Green/Red ratio) and anti-HMGB1 intensity report 'n=20' directly on the panel, but neither the panel nor the caption specifies what this n represents (e.g., cells counted, images, or independent experiments), so the replicate type is not reported.

Panel C shows a single representative Western blot (HMGB1 and GAPDH) confirming knockdown from panel B, with no statement of how many times the blot/experiment was repeated or what type of replicate it represents.

The SDH and COX quantification graphs report numeric N values directly in the bars (15/15/15 and 23/26/23, respectively) per the note 'N: indicated in the bars', but neither the panel nor the caption specifies what these numbers count (e.g., number of Purkinje cells, sections, or animals), so the replicate type is not reported.

replicate_statements: The results from three sets of independent transfection experiments indicated that the mitochondrial membrane potential and mitochondrial permeability transition were changed by the deficiency in HMGB1.
outputs.replicate_type: three sets of independent transfection experiments
